csv_scope_of_work: The JCHA requires the services of a company to provide Architectural and Engineering Services "As Needed", For Various Jersey City Housing Locations. The JCHA periodically requires the services of one or more design professionals including architects, planners, landscape architects, civil engineers, mechanical, electrical, plumbing and structural engineers, surveyors, etc. to supplement the staff of design professionals at the Housing Authority. The purpose of this Request For Proposals is to solicit responses from the most talented and most qualified design professionals in and around the State of New Jersey, from which the Jersey City Housing Authority can select a single Primary Contractor (with or without a team of Sub-Consultants) as the provider of these services for the Housing Authority's many Development and Modernization project
